data.value: The Antigravity CLI (agy) passes your plan quota per model (remaining share and reset time) to the status line command you configure. To make AIUsage that command, add this entry to {0} (merge it with the settings already there). Antigravity keeps its own status line and shows AIUsage's line below it.

data.name: AntigravityNote
data.value: AIUsage keeps only the quota percentages and reset times. Your e-mail address, folders, conversation and tokens that the CLI also sends are discarded. AIUsage never reads Google credentials, never signs in and never contacts Google. Limits update only while you use the Antigravity CLI in a terminal, not from the Antigravity IDE. Antigravity token usage and costs are not shown: they are not available locally in a documented, readable form. Update the path if you move AIUsage to another folder.
